newsitem.title: USA: Envirotest starts equity, debt tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Envirotest starts equity, debt tender offer.

text.p: Envirotest Systems Corp said Tuesday it began its previously authorized equity tender offer for up to 4,444,444 shares of its outstanding class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share.
In addition, the company said it began its previously authorized tender offer to buy up to $50 million principal amount of its outstanding 9.125 percent senior notes due 2001.
The company said the share offer represents 24.3 percent of its outstanding shares of common stock, including vested options and shares of class B and class C common stock.
Shareholders will tender shares of common stock at prices not greater than $4.50 nor less than $3.75 per share.

The company said it will determine the single lowest per share price within that price range that will allow it to buy up to 4,444,444 shares of common stock based upon the number of shares tendered and the prices specified by shareholders.
If the tender offer were oversubscribed, shares tendered at or below the purchase price would be subject to proration.
The equity tender offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of shares being tendered.
The expiration of the offer to purchase up to $50 million of 9.125 percent notes is a condition precedent to the completion of the equity tender offer.
Both offerings will expire on September 17, unless extended.
The company said it expects to fund the debt and equity tender offers from cash on hand.
